additional_explicit_missing_test_impleme.E2E-08-fifo-and-escaping-paths: FIFO reports, symlink escapes, and external report destinations are not safely fault-induced by this runner interface.
additional_explicit_missing_test_impleme.E2E-11-unrelated-syntax-diagnostic: The exact syntax control is checked, but an unrelated compiler error mentioning syntax.ml is not independently induced.
additional_explicit_missing_test_impleme.E2E-12-independent-container-lifetime: The runner enforces a deadline, but this harness has no independent daemon-side container lifetime observer.
additional_explicit_missing_test_impleme.E2E-05-retained-pipe-and-interruption: The runner supervisor cannot be independently interrupted without an external owned-process harness.
additional_explicit_missing_test_impleme.E2E-07-build-cancellation: This E2E does not build images; daemon-side build cancellation cannot be proven here.
additional_explicit_missing_test_impleme.E2E-13-integrity-canaries: The runner does not expose fixed execution canaries for every integrity gate.
additional_explicit_missing_test_impleme.E2E-14-startup-failure: No owned missing-entrypoint image variant is supplied by the fixed three-argument interface.
additional_explicit_missing_test_impleme.E2E-16-concurrent-same-id: Concurrent same-ID reservation is not exercised by this bounded serial driver.
additional_explicit_missing_test_impleme.E2E-17-report-namespace: Invalid-ID and complete namespace preservation controls are not exposed by the runner contract.
additional_explicit_missing_test_impleme.E2E-18-daemon-log-retention: Build, remove, and absence-query daemon logs are not persisted as separate evidence artifacts by the runner.
additional_explicit_missing_test_impleme.E2E-19-full-input-snapshot: Reviewed runner, Dockerfile, fixture, and E2E hashes are checked; a full original/candidate tree snapshot is not part of this fixed harness.
